authority.runtime: The old mutation owner remains terminal. A fresh bounded ObjectStore child has exactly AdapterNet, AdapterAuth and ObserveStatus under the exact resource, with separate operation/deadline/budget. authority.filesystem: Original journal is exclusively opened and borrowed immutably for observation. Source media is not read. A separate exactly scoped private receipt path uses exclusive creation, finite accounting, stable readback and file/parent fsync.

findings.finding: HEAD metadata/checksums alone could match an older completed object from a different journal with identical semantic intent while the current conditional completion returned 412 and staging remained active.
findings.repair: Require exact signed pre-initiation custody origin. The fixture uses two real journals, distinct UploadIds/origins, identical semantic metadata, a first successful completion and a second 412; the second must remain uncertain.

findings.finding: The CLI pending-owner reconciliation branch did not report terminal receipt/local settlement when StagedUpload::reconcile successfully settled the child.
findings.repair: Retrieve its idempotent terminal receipt, mark settlement and close actual parent scopes without another provider mutation.

findings.finding: Receipt writing needed a stable stamp across exact readback and parent fsync to reject same-size rewrites during verification.
findings.repair: Compare full descriptor and pathname identity/length/mtime/ctime before and after readback and after parent fsync.

contracts.origin: SHA256 of canonical fss.multipart_custody_origin.v1, namespace digest, first committed sequence and root. Default unproven journal binding is None. The original independently retained pin and full verified namespace-bound history remain required.
contracts.old_uploads: Objects created before origin metadata was added cannot be positively reconciled by this HEAD path. Missing origin metadata remains Unknown; ordinary successfully acknowledged uploads retain their original meaning.
contracts.observation: The historical upload's phase, local indeterminate proof and original spend remain unchanged. The new receipt is separately linked evidence, not a reopened uploader or a rewritten checkpoint. One admitted read per owner; no auto retry, Create, UploadPart, Complete or Abort.
contracts.receipt: fss.multipart_completion_observation.v1 canonical bytes, at most64KiB; exact source pin, old closure proof, original and fresh operations, immutable intent/plan/root, full inert authority, timestamps, spend, explicit outcome and optional completion digest. No object path, provider tokens, credentials, body or media.
contracts.cli: upload-s3-reconcile retains original source/route/operation/plan plus independent minimum pin, adds --observation-operation and --observation-receipt; its deadline/memory/wire/request bounds authorize only fresh observation. Result schema fss.s3_completion_observation_cli.v1 is complete JSON at most16KiB.
contracts.durability: Receipt output uses create_new with private permissions, finite admissions, complete writes, file fsync, exact stable readback and parent fsync. Ambiguous/partial outputs remain for inspection and are never overwritten. Success requires conclusive completion and confirmed durable receipt.
contracts.compatibility: No checkpoint, owner or journal-record encoding changes. UploadJournal origin accessor defaults to None; transparent fault wrappers delegate it. Existing mutation commands and v1 report remain. Native non-durable acknowledged uploads still work, but cannot acquire positive HEAD completion evidence.
